priorityList: Keep Arcane Intellect active and cast Mirror Image before entering combat.
Activate Combustion while finishing a cast (Scorch, Fireball, or Flamestrike) or immediately after a Meteor lands.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions while Combustion is active, ideally with more than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Meteor during Combustion if it has at least 2 seconds remaining, or when Combustion is about to become available to trigger Sunfury effects.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if there are 4 or more targets (3 or more outside of Combustion) and you have the Fuel the Fire talent.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Pyroblast if you are against fewer than 4 targets or Fuel the Fire is not talented.
During Hyperthermia procs, spam Flamestrike if 4 or more targets are present, otherwise spam Pyroblast.
Use Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (4+ targets) or Pyroblast if Combustion has more than 12 seconds remaining on cooldown or you have 2 stacks.
Use Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into a Hot Streak while mid-cast of another spell.
Do not use Fire Blast if you already have a Hot Streak proc ready or if you are currently casting a spell that will consume the Heating Up.
Use Scorch as your primary filler during Combustion to maximize ignite and generate procs.
Use Scorch as your filler outside of Combustion if the target is below 30% health or if Heat Shimmer procs.
Use Scorch as your filler in AoE (4+ targets) even when above 30% health to benefit from Sunfury mechanics.
Cast Fireball as your default filler when targets are above 30% health and no other procs or priorities are active.
